title: Welcome to Prathyusha Engineering College - Campus Tour & Facilities Overview
full_caption: Explore Prathyusha Engineering College (PEC), an autonomous institution affiliated with Anna University and accredited by NAAC with A+ grade. Located on Poonamallee-Tiruvallur High Road, Chennai. Featuring smart classrooms, state-of-the-art AR-VR Center of Excellence, AI & Robotics Labs, Idea Lab, sports complex, hygienic hostels, Wi-Fi enabled campus, and 100% placement training support.
venue: Prathyusha Engineering College Campus, Chennai-Tiruvallur Highway
speaker: Principal & Faculty Heads
registration_info: Admissions open for B.E/B.Tech programmes. Enquire at admissions office.
transcript: Welcome to Prathyusha Engineering College. Established with a commitment to excellence in engineering education, our campus spans over 45 lush green acres equipped with advanced research facilities, 13 innovation domains, dedicated training centers, and modern hostel accommodation for men and women.

title: Hands-on National Workshop on Generative AI and LLM Application Engineering
full_caption: The Department of Computer Science and Engineering (CSE) in collaboration with Google Developer Student Club (GDSC) at Prathyusha Engineering College successfully organized a two-day hands-on National Workshop on 'Generative AI and Large Language Model Application Engineering'. Over 180 students participated. Resource Person: Dr. R. Ramanathan, Principal AI Architect at Cognizant. Participants built real-time RAG applications and conversational agents. Certificates and project kits were awarded to top performing teams.
organizer: Department of CSE & Google Developer Student Club
venue: Dr. K.R. Meganathan Memorial Auditorium & Turing Computing Lab
speaker: Dr. R. Ramanathan, Principal AI Architect, Cognizant
registration_info: Registration fee: Rs. 200 for PEC students, Rs. 350 for external participants via college portal.

title: PRATHYUSHA IGNITE 2026 - 24-Hour National Hackathon
full_caption: Highlights from PRATHYUSHA IGNITE 2026! 🚀 An intense 24-hour inter-college hackathon hosted by the Innovation & Entrepreneurship Cell across 13 Innovation Domains including Smart Agriculture, MedTech, Robotics & Automation, and FinTech. 85 teams from 32 engineering institutions competed for cash prizes worth Rs. 1,50,000. Hearty congratulations to Team 'AgroNova' from Department of AI & Data Science for clinching the First Prize for their Autonomous Drone Crop Health Monitoring System!
organizer: Idea Lab & AR-VR Center of Excellence
venue: PEC Central Library Tech Lounge & Innovation Hub
speaker: Mr. Karthik Sundaram, Vice President, Startup TN

title: Campus Placement Drive 2026 — Marquee Offers & Top Recruiters
full_caption: Proud announcement from the Training and Placement Cell at Prathyusha Engineering College! Over 420 offers rolled out so far for the graduating batch of 2026. Top recruiters include Zoho, TCS Ninja & Digital, Cognizant, Wipro, Infosys, Kaar Technologies, Renault Nissan, and Virtusa. Highest package: Rs. 12 LPA. Average package: Rs. 4.8 LPA. Intensive preparatory training including LeetCode coding modules, soft-skill mock interviews, and group discussions proved pivotal in this success.
speaker: Director of Placement & Corporate Relations
registration_info: Eligible final and pre-final year students register on Superset placement portal.

title: Traditional Pongal Celebrations 'Uzhavar Thirunal 2026'
full_caption: Colors of tradition, beats of chenda melam, and sweet pongal joy! 🌾✨ Prathyusha Engineering College celebrated 'Uzhavar Thirunal 2026' with grand traditional gaiety. Students and staff gathered in vibrant traditional attire. Competitions included Rangoli/Kolam, Uri Adithal, Tug of War, and Traditional Music performances. Fresh sweet pongal was cooked and distributed to all students, hostelers, and faculty members.
venue: College Open Air Amphitheatre & Central Courtyard
speaker: Chairman, CEO & Principal
registration_info: Open to all students and staff.

title: Student Achievement: Biotechnology Team Wins National Bio-Innovation Award
full_caption: Hearty congratulations to the final year Biotechnology students from Prathyusha Engineering College for securing the National Bio-Innovation Award at the National Bio-Tech Summit 2026. Their project focuses on 'Low-Cost Biodegradable Packaging Films Developed from Marine Algae Biomass' guided by Dr. S. Malathi, Professor and HOD of Biotechnology. Watch the research presentation and student interviews.
speaker: Dr. S. Malathi (HOD Biotech) and Student Innovators
registration_info: Research funded under institutional innovation seed grant.
transcript: Hello everyone. Our research project addresses single-use plastic pollution by deriving starch-cellulose biocomposites from sustainable sea algae harvested locally. With the constant guidance of our faculty at Prathyusha Engineering College and access to state-of-the-art analytical instrumentation, our prototype passed biodegradability benchmarks within 45 days.

title: International Guest Lecture & Drone Demonstration on Autonomous Aerial Robotics
full_caption: The Drones Club and Yantramanav Robotics Club of Prathyusha Engineering College organized an International Technical Lecture on 'Autonomous Aerial Navigation and Swarm Robotics in Disaster Management'. Guest Speaker: Dr. Mark Henderson, Senior Robotics Researcher from National University of Singapore. Followed by a live field demonstration of autonomous quadcopter waypoint navigation in the PEC main ground.
organizer: Drones Club, Yantramanav & IEEE Student Branch
speaker: Dr. Mark Henderson, NUS Robotics Lab
registration_info: Free registration for Drones Club and Yantramanav members.

title: First Year Orientation & Freshers Induction Programme 'AARAMBH'
full_caption: A warm welcome to the Class of 2026-2030! 🎓✨ Prathyusha Engineering College held 'AARAMBH', the Induction and Orientation Programme for incoming first-year B.E./B.Tech students and parents. Highlights included address by the Principal on academic regulations, Anna University curriculum, mentor-mentee system, dress code norms, anti-ragging measures, and campus club showcases.
speaker: Principal, Dean of Academics, First Year Coordinator
registration_info: Mandatory orientation for all enrolled first year students.
